text:
alex: Hey team — saw a spike in fragmentation on the g1-prod pool after the last density change. Quick idea: introduce a ‘hazard token’ compaction trigger per arena that accumulates when frees create holes and gets consumed to do targeted coalesces instead of global compaction. Thoughts?
maria: Hmm — sounds like a per-arena budget for reclaim work. Could help avoid pausey full compactions. how do you envision tokens being minted?
sam: Could mint on frees where the free size > X and the surrounding region is non-contiguous. Or mint based on a sampling of allocation/search failures. Keeps cost proportional to churn.
nora: Are we talking about reclaiming into existing slabs or moving resident pages between slabs? moving pages is expensive across GPU/host.
alex: Good call. Plan is two-tier: token-triggered light coalesce (merge adjacent free spans in host backing) vs token-burn heavy compaction (migrate live blocks to reduce tail fragmentation). Heavy compaction only when token pool > threshold and latency budget allowed.
perf-bot: perf-check started: baseline vs hazard-token-sim  (scripts/perf/hazard-run.sh) — will post numbers in ~30m :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maria: How would this interact with our prefetch/pinning heuristics? If we compact aggressively we might thrash pinned pages.
sam: We should add pin-awareness: don't migrate pages pinned by active k/v cache or GPU contexts. Token logic should decrement if we detect pin conflicts.
nora: Also consider tenant fairness — one noisy job could accumulate tokens and trigger heavy compaction affecting others. Maybe tokens have per-tenant caps and a global rate limiter.
alex: Agreed. Proposal: tokens are per-arena + per-tenant. A background worker does token reconciliation and applies a token budget slice per epoch to prevent big bursts. fallback: if global low-memory, escalate with immediate heavy compaction as a backstop.
maria: Can we express this as config plumbed through the runtime? example config:
```yaml
allocator:
  compaction_mode: hazard-token
  hazard:
    mint_on_free_size: 1MB
    heavy_threshold: 128
    tenant_cap: 32
    epoch_slice_ms: 50
    pin_ignore_window_ms: 200
```
sam: Looks ok. We should also expose metrics: hazard_tokens_total, hazard_tokens_burned, hazard_compactions_heavy, hazard_compactions_light, hazard_pin_conflicts. Will be useful for perf alerts.
perf-bot: perf-check finished: small alloc pattern (chatty small tensors) -> hazard-token reduced global compaction events by ~68% and P99 latency improved 20%. Large-model pinned flows saw +3% page moves due to misconfig.
nora: Nice. For the pinned flows we can add a conservative `pin_ignore_window_ms` and a quick pin-check path before migrating.
alex: Next steps: open a short RFC describing token lifecycle, tenant caps, metrics, and the background reconciler. @maria take config and metrics, @sam take migration safety (pins/contexts), I'll draft perf spike notes. Anyone object?
maria: fine by me :+1:
sam: happy to own migration safety.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: allocator/hazard-token feature-flag -> canary on g1-prod-2 at 2026-03-15T22:00Z
alex: will upload a prototype branch and the RFC link here when ready. Thanks all.
